description: This file is a Node.js script for profiling extension memory usage (RSS) in a project. It includes functions for parsing arguments, running profiling cases, handling external extension entrypoints, and generating reports based on memory measurements.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and help information for running the profiling script.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments provided to the script, returning an options object with configuration settings.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Extracts the maximum resident set size (RSS) in megabytes from standard error output.

methods.name: summarizeStderr
methods.description: Creates a summarized preview string of the first few lines of stderr output.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Executes a profiling case in a child process, capturing stdout, stderr, exit code, and maximum RSS.

methods.name: buildImportBody
methods.description: Builds the JavaScript code body for importing specified entry files and signaling completion.

methods.name: findExtensionEntries
methods.description: Finds built extension entry files within the project directory structure.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function orchestrating the memory profiling workflow, including setup, execution, and reporting.
